Creature Editor

Design a monster, boss or critter and fight it straight away. Start from a base model, pick a body plan, then change its features, colours, how it moves and how it warns you before it attacks. The settings can be copied out as text and pasted back in later.

Poses

Standing, moving, warning before an attack, attacking, and stunned.

Arena

Every creature in the arena shows the current design. Hold still freezes them so you can look closely.

Controls

WASD
Move. Hold Shift to sprint
J or Left click
Attack
K or Right click
Block. Press just before a hit to parry
Space
Dash

Base models

Body plan

A base model is a complete starting creature. Changing the body plan keeps the colours and features.

Shape

Head size applies to the Critter and Brute. Leg count applies to the Crawler, arm length to the Brute.

Eyes

Mouth

Pattern

Tails show on the Blob, Critter and Crawler.

Behaviour

Speed, warning time and lunge speed apply to the Lunger. Health applies to newly added creatures.
